name.value: SureStay Plus Hotel by Best Western Salmon Arm

description.value: A newly renovated hotel situated directly off the Trans-Canada Highway in Salmon Arm, roughly halfway between Vancouver and Calgary. Shuswap Lake is a short walk away, and the broader area offers over 1,400 kilometres of hiking and biking trails. Part of the BWH Hotels / Best Western family, it offers standard chain-hotel amenities in a convenient highway-accessible location.
